div.div: يُرَنَّأٌ (S, K) and يَرَنَّأٌ and يُرَنَّآءٌ (K) and يُرَنَّا (without ء) and (accord. to [the Bári', as mentioned in] the TA, art. رنأ,) يَرْنَأٌ and يُرْنَأٌ and (accord. to MF, who omits the two forms here immediately preceding,) يَرَنَّاءٌ and يَرَنَّا, without ء, (TA,) i. q. حِنَّاءٌ (S, K) [The plant Lawsonia inermis]. See also art. رنأ, where the word is written [erroneously in my opinion] يَرُنَّأٌ. Accord. to IB (not IJ [as in the CK]), the may only be omitted when the word is pronounced with dammeh to the ى. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
